title: Grounding Synthetic Data Evaluations of Language Models in Unsupervised Document Corpora
reasoning: The paper focuses on a methodology for automating the construction of fact-based synthetic evaluations grounded in document populations. It does not evaluate religion, faith, or ethics; although an example question about Queen Victoria mentions 'Victorian morality', this is used as a test case for grounding accuracy rather than a study of ethics or morals itself.
